interfaces.title: Read-only plan quality summary
inputs: A resolved requirement directory containing an optional PLAN.json.
outputs: quality_summary(rdir) returns an envelope with state, summary and errors.
ready carries the unmodified existing quality analyzer dictionary and an empty errors list.
absent carries no summary and an empty errors list.
invalid carries no summary and safe diagnostic strings without absolute paths.
invariants: Use validated module loading and its existing analyzer; do not recompute graph metrics in the web layer.
Only missing PLAN.json produces absent; malformed, invalid, unreadable and oversized files produce invalid.
Do not mutate files, execute verification commands, resolve workspaces or invoke approval, freeze or launch operations.
Only the adapter imports the planner module.
The existing terminal report JSON and exit behavior remain unchanged.
D1 is a proposed error-policy decision, not recorded owner approval.
integration_criteria: The branching fixture produces identical critical path, widest level and low-confidence IDs through CLI, adapter and actual Plan page.
Absent produces exact legacy rendering and invalid produces the proposed escaped unavailable warning without metrics.
Artifact comparisons demonstrate no writes from summary reads.
